description: DesignerFocusSurface is controlled: it takes focused and onFocusedChange and holds no storage of its own

useDesignerFocusPreference(designer) in packages/user-composition/src/hooks returns { isFocused, setFocused, toggle }, built on useUserPreference<boolean> with key designer_focus_mode_<designer> and default false
The five designers (service_request_form, invoice_layout, quote_layout, document_layout, workflow) are a typed union; each has its own preference key and changing one never changes another
Toggling saves the new value to the signed-in user's preferences and to the local cache under the same key, as useUserPreference does for view modes
A toggle made before the account value has loaded is kept and saved; the late-arriving value does not overwrite it
If the account value cannot be loaded or saved, the cached or default value is used and the toggle keeps working for the visit
The hook is importable as @alga-psa/user-composition/hooks/useDesignerFocusPreference and is also listed in the hooks index
DesignerFocusSurface renders one element carrying idPrefix as its id, the host className, and data-focus-mode="off" when unfocused
When focused the same element carries fixed inset-0 z-40, the page background token and a flex column, plus the host's focusedClassName, and data-focus-mode="on"
Changing focused changes classes on the same element; children are not remounted and keep their state
The surface provides a context; useDesignerFocusState() returns { isFocused, toggle } inside a surface and { isFocused: false, toggle: no-op } outside one
DesignerFocusToggle renders an icon button with the given id, Maximize2 when unfocused and Minimize2 when focused, aria-pressed reflecting the state, and calls toggle on click
DesignerFocusToggle renders nothing when there is no surface above it
The surface, toggle and state hook are exported from @alga-psa/ui/components/designer
Shortcut catalog gains designer.toggleFocusMode in the editor group: mod+., page scope, allowInEditable
DesignerFocusSurface registers designer.toggleFocusMode while mounted; the shortcut toggles that surface and is unregistered on unmount
The shortcut fires while focus is in an input, textarea or contenteditable inside the designer
msp/keyboard-shortcuts has actions.designer.toggleFocusMode label and description in en, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, sv and the xx / yy pseudo-locales, so the help dialog lists it under Editor
common namespace has designer.focusMode.enter and designer.focusMode.exit in every production locale and both pseudo-locales; the toggle uses them for its tooltip and accessible name
The toggle tooltip shows the shortcut through the shortcut display helper, so the platform modifier and a customised binding render correctly
ServiceRequestFormBuilderPage no longer wraps the builder in a fixed full-window layer; the builder fills the height of the MSP content area with the sidebar and header visible
The builder is wrapped in DesignerFocusSurface driven by the service_request_form preference read in the page component; the surface keeps the id service-request-form-builder-surface
The builder toolbar has the focus toggle with id service-request-form-builder-focus-toggle, placed before Publish
With no manual palette choice in this visit, the palette is collapsed while the surface is narrower than 1100 px
With no manual palette choice in this visit, the palette expands when the surface reaches 1100 px or wider, including on entering focus mode
After the user collapses or expands the palette by hand, width changes and focus toggles no longer change it for the rest of the visit
The loading text and the load-failed alert render in the normal layout regardless of the saved preference
Back link, save status, notice banner, draft restore banner, Try it mode and Publish are inside the surface and work in both modes
Toggling focus mode keeps the form document, undo / redo history, selection, inspector width and left tab
Billing DesignerShell reads useDesignerFocusState(); unfocused, or outside any surface, its root keeps h-[calc(100vh-24.75rem)] min-h-[480px]
Focused, the billing DesignerShell root fills its parent (flex-1 min-h-0) with no viewport-based height and no minimum height
The billing DesignerShell edit adds no hard-coded palette classes; themeContract.paletteBaseline stays at its pinned count
InvoiceTemplateEditor is wrapped in DesignerFocusSurface, driven by the invoice_layout preference
The invoice editor header action group has the focus toggle with id invoice-template-editor-focus-toggle, placed before Close
In focus mode the invoice editor card fills the surface without border, radius or shadow, and the header row stays at the top

In focus mode the card content, the Visual / Code tabs, the designer wrapper and the Design / Transforms / Preview tabs in DesignerVisualWorkspace pass the remaining height down so the Design shell fills the window
In focus mode the Transforms, Preview and Code views scroll inside the surface; the page behind does not scroll
The Code editor's computed height is recalculated when focus mode is toggled
Toggling focus mode keeps the invoice designer workspace, selection, undo history, template name edits and the active tabs

QuoteDocumentTemplateEditor renders as one Card with a compact header row and the Visual / Code tabs in its content; the page title block, description paragraph, Layout Details card and footer are removed
The header row starts with back navigation labelled Back to Quote Layouts, keeping id quote-template-editor-back and using the editor's existing back behaviour (onBack, else the quote layouts tab)
The title is a compact heading reading 'Edit Layout: <name>' for an existing layout and 'New Quote Layout' for a new one, and truncates instead of wrapping the row
The Template Name input sits inline in the header with id quote-template-name-input, takes the spare width, and is disabled while loading
The Version input sits inline in the header as a narrow number input with id quote-template-version-input, clamped to integers of at least 1, disabled while loading
The saved status shows 'Saved <time>' from updated_at or 'Not saved yet', has aria-live polite, and carries the created date as its tooltip
Close (id quote-template-editor-close) and Save Layout (id quote-template-editor-save) sit at the right of the row; Close uses the back behaviour; Save is disabled while saving or loading
A load or save error alert renders inside the card header, under the row
On a narrow window the header row wraps onto further lines; nothing overflows or is clipped
In the normal layout the quote editor's Design view fits the window with no page scroll on /msp/billing?tab=quote-templates and on /msp/quote-document-templates

msp/quotes has the new header strings (back to quote layouts, title with name, saved at, not saved yet, close) in every production locale and both pseudo-locales; strings used only by the removed description, details card and footer are deleted
Loading an existing layout, creating one from a standard code, saving, and the sample / existing-quote preview behave as before the reorganisation
DocumentTemplateEditor renders as one Card with a compact header row and the Visual / Code tabs in its content; the page title block, description paragraph, Layout Details card and footer are removed
The header row starts with back navigation labelled 'Back to <Type> Layouts' for the current document type, keeping id document-template-editor-back and calling onCancel
The title is a compact heading reading 'Edit Layout: <name>' for an existing layout and 'New <Type> Layout' for a new one, and truncates instead of wrapping the row
The Template Name input sits inline in the header, keeps id document-template-name-input and its type-specific placeholder, and takes the spare width
The Version input sits inline in the header as a narrow number input, keeps id document-template-version-input and its clamp to integers of at least 1
For work-tag layouts the header has a Label settings button with id document-template-label-settings; other document types do not render it
Label settings opens a popover holding the label class select, the field checkboxes and their hint, with their existing ids; the popover stays open while the select and checkboxes are used
Label class and hidden fields keep their state while the popover is closed and are saved with the layout exactly as before
The saved status shows 'Saved <time>' from updated_at or 'Not saved yet', has aria-live polite, and carries the created date as its tooltip
Close (id document-template-editor-close) and Save Layout (id document-template-editor-save) sit at the right of the row; Close calls onCancel; Save is disabled while saving
A load or save error alert renders inside the card header, under the row
In the normal layout the document editor's Design view fits the window with no page scroll, and the header row wraps rather than overflows on a narrow window

msp/invoicing has the new documentTemplates.editor header strings (back to type layouts, title with name, saved at, not saved yet, close, label settings) in every production locale and both pseudo-locales; strings used only by the removed description, details heading and footer are deleted
Loading, saving and the sample / existing-document preview behave as before the reorganisation for every document type
QuoteDocumentTemplateEditor is wrapped in DesignerFocusSurface, driven by the quote_layout preference, and has the toggle with id quote-template-editor-focus-toggle in the header row before Close
In focus mode the quote editor keeps its whole header row; name, version, saved status, Close and Save stay visible and editable, and the card loses its border, radius and shadow
In focus mode the quote editor's card content, tab sets and designer wrapper pass the remaining height down so the Design shell fills the window
In focus mode the quote editor's Transforms, Preview and Code views scroll inside the surface
The quote editor's focus mode works and shares one saved preference on /msp/billing?tab=quote-templates and /msp/quote-document-templates
DocumentTemplateEditor is wrapped in DesignerFocusSurface, driven by the document_layout preference, and has the toggle with id document-template-editor-focus-toggle in the header row before Close
In focus mode the document editor keeps its whole header row; name, version, Label settings, saved status, Close and Save stay visible and usable, and the card loses its border, radius and shadow
In focus mode the document editor's card content, tab sets and designer wrapper pass the remaining height down so the Design shell fills the window
In focus mode the document editor's Transforms, Preview and Code views scroll inside the surface
The document editor's saved preference is the same for every document type
Toggling focus mode in the quote and document editors keeps the designer workspace, name and version edits and the active tabs
WorkflowDesigner's root is wrapped in DesignerFocusSurface, driven by the workflow preference, when it renders in designer mode
The designer-mode header action group has the focus toggle with id workflow-designer-focus-toggle
The workflow list and control panel modes show no toggle and never render focused, whatever the saved preference
The floating palette and properties panels are positioned correctly after entering and after leaving focus mode
In focus mode the graph view fills the available height instead of the fixed 650 px, with 650 px as its minimum
In focus mode the properties panel's maximum height uses the space freed by the hidden chrome
The payload schema, trigger schema and published contract modals render above a focused workflow designer
Toggling focus mode keeps the workflow draft, the selected step, the list / graph view and the properties panel width
